bias.en: Downtrend · SAR flipped bearish, on the 200-day
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · SAR 转为看空，回踩 200 日均线

read.en: Palantir fell 2.4% on Nov 17 to $156.56, trading $153.91–162.59. It is below the 10-day ($165.4), 5-day ($165.8), 100-day ($167.6) and 30-day ($185.7, falling), and above the 200-day ($153.8, rising). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 17 ($175.41), and RSI is 32.8.
read.zh: Palantir 11月17日下跌 2.4%，收于 $156.56，盘中区间 $153.91–162.59。股价位于 10 日（$165.4）、5 日（$165.8）、100 日（$167.6）和 30 日均线（$185.7，下行）下方，位于 200 日均线（$153.8，上行）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 于 11月17日转为看空（$175.41），RSI 为 32.8。

read.en: The drop broke the $157.2–158.7 support (Nov 6 and 16 lows), now resistance, and flipped the SAR; the $153.91 low held the 200-day. Resistance is $157.2–158.7, then $160.4–162.6 (Nov 6 and 16 closes, Nov 17 high) and $165.4–167.6 (10, 5 and 100-day). Support is $153.8–153.9 (200-day, Nov 17 low), then $152.6 (Nov 5 low) and $150. A close above $158.7 would target $160–163; below $152.6, $150.
